comments.author: @LONEWOLF-rq5tl
comments.text: I live in Mississippi next to Jackson and Katrina SUCKED big time even all the way up here. We were completely out of power for 2 weeks and had alot of storm damage and the couple stores that were open that had gas,ice etc couldn't keep anything in stock for long. The lines at these stores were so long that it took you almost an hour 45 minutes just to get up to the front of the line and pray they weren't out of anything. I know better than anyone because 1 night I waited in line with a buddy of mine for well over an hour just to get to the front and realize I left my wallet at the house. I remember that crap like yesterday and it still pisses me off. It was so hot down here that we slept in our cars because it was a sauna inside the house so we didn't stay in there as much as possible but we had to be mindful running the cars alot as well because of the lack of gas obviously! Yeah it sucked and the world isn't ready for shit to really hit the fan I'll tell you that much but I've known that for YEARS!! It just sucked for us because we couldn't sleep with the air on and were hot and sticky and that's all but it want too bad though because we're from the DIRTY SOUTH and we're used to working in the heat most of the day anyways and we were just worried about the older people around us that us. We adapted VERY QUICKLY though like we always do.  Us southerners are literally build differently and I'm not joking,we will adapt to most things within minutes.
